차례마다 맨 위 카드와 색이 같거나(♥♦는 빨강, ♠♣는 검정) 숫자가: On each turn, a player can play one card that has the same color as the top card (♥♦ are red, ♠♣ are black) or the same rank. A Joker can be played at any time on a turn when the player is not under attack. 2, A, and Joker are attack cards. When an attack card is played, the next player comes under attack. The number of cards to receive is 2 cards for a 2, 3 cards for an A, and 5 cards for a Joker. The player under attack can block by playing an attack card, and then the card counts are added together and the attack passes to the next player. If the player cannot block, they receive as many cards as the added-up count, and the attack ends. On a turn when the player is under attack, only attack cards can be played. The blocking card must not be weaker than the top card (strength is 2 < A < Joker), and unless it is a Joker, it must have the same color or rank as the top card.
차례마다 맨 위 카드와 무늬가 같거나 숫자가 같은 카드 한 장을 낼 수: On each turn, a player can play one card that has the same suit as the top card or the same rank. A Joker can be played at any time on a turn when the player is not under attack. 2, A, and Joker are attack cards. When an attack card is played, the next player comes under attack. The number of cards to receive is 2 cards for a 2, 3 cards for an A, and 5 cards for a Joker. The player under attack can block by playing an attack card, and then the card counts are added together and the attack passes to the next player. If the player cannot block, they receive as many cards as the added-up count, and the attack ends. On a turn when the player is under attack, only attack cards can be played. The blocking card must not be weaker than the top card (strength is 2 < A < Joker), and unless it is a Joker, it must have the same suit or rank as the top card.
카드는 무늬(♠♥♦♣)와 숫자를 붙여 \"♥7\", \"♠A\"처럼 쓴다: A card is written by joining its suit (♠♥♦♣) and rank, as in "♥7", "♠A". A Joker is written as "Joker". ♥♦ are red, ♠♣ are black.
지금 내 차례이고 공격은 받지 않았다. 내가 낼 수 있는 카드는?: It is my turn now and I am not under attack. Which card can I play?
맨 위 카드: ♠2 (공격 중)\n내 손패: ♥3 ♥A ♥5:
Top card: ♠2 (attack in progress)
My hand: ♥3 ♥A ♥5
앞 사람이 공격 카드를 내서 지금 내가 공격을 받고 있다. 막을 수 있는: The previous player played an attack card, so I am now under attack. Which card can block?
공격 전 맨 위 카드: ♥6\n그 뒤 나온 카드(순서대로): ♥A, ♦A:
Top card before the attack: ♥6
Cards played after that (in order): ♥A, ♦A, ♠A, Joker
지금 내 차례이고 공격을 받고 있다. 내가 막지 못하면 카드를 몇 장 받: It is my turn now and I am under attack. If I cannot block, how many cards do I receive?
맨 위 카드: ♠8 (공격 없음)\n내 손패: ♥9 ♦8 ♦7 ♠3 ♣1:
Top card: ♠8 (no attack)
My hand: ♥9 ♦8 ♦7 ♠3 ♣10
Next player's last card: ♦J
The next player has one card left, and everyone knows what that card is. To keep the next player from playing that card, which of the cards I can play now must I play?
맨 위 카드: ♠K (공격 없음)\n내 손패: ♥9 ♣9 ♠3 ♦K\n다:
Top card: ♠K (no attack)
My hand: ♥9 ♣9 ♠3 ♦K
Next player's last card: ♦A
맨 위 카드: ♣10 (공격 없음)\n내 손패: ♣4 ♠Q ♠2 ♦4 ♠:
Top card: ♣10 (no attack)
My hand: ♣4 ♠Q ♠2 ♦4 ♠10
Next player's last card: ♠6
